g.text: Project laptops (company) - latest UbuntuLTS, full-disk encryption
Project laptops (contractor) - latestUbuntu LTS, full-disk encryption
CDSE and DestinE EarthDataHub - HTTPS endpoints
OVHcloud - Public Cloud project, region GRA (Gravelines, France)
OVHcloud Object Storage (S3, regionGRA) - public HTTPS endpoint
Public zone (ops) - Ext-Net, public IP addresses
Kubernetes control plane (managed byOVHcloud) - API 6443 restricted to thebastion IP

Filtering (OpenStack security groups and MKS IP restrictions):- bastion: SSH 22/tcp from the company and contractor IP addresses only- load balancer: HTTPS 443 from the Internet- Kubernetes API: 6443/tcp from the bastion IP address onlyManaged services (object storage, registries, OVHcloud APIs) expose authenticated publicHTTPS endpoints, reached by the cluster nodes through the router.
Public zone (dev) - Ext-Net, public IP addresses
Same network design and filtering as the production environment. Administration through thedev bastion only.
